name: alignment
example: Please check the alignment of the icons and labels in the sidebar.
exampleTrans: 请检查一下侧边栏里图标和文字标签的对齐。

name: spacing
example: The spacing between these cards feels inconsistent on smaller screens.
exampleTrans: 这些卡片之间的间距在小屏幕上显得不一致。

name: padding
example: Add sixteen pixels of padding inside the card so the text can breathe.
exampleTrans: 在卡片内部加十六像素的内边距，让文字更透气。

name: margin
example: The left margin on mobile should match the header, not the content.
exampleTrans: 移动端的左外边距应该和页头对齐，而不是和内容对齐。

name: layout
example: I tried three layouts for the settings page and prefer the two-column one.
exampleTrans: 我给设置页试了三种布局，更喜欢双栏的那个。

name: grid
example: Everything on this page sits on a twelve-column grid with fixed gutters.
exampleTrans: 这个页面上的所有元素都基于固定槽宽的十二列栅格。

name: component
example: Turn this card into a component so we can reuse it across screens.
exampleTrans: 把这个卡片做成组件，这样就能在各个页面复用。

name: design system
example: Before creating a new button, check whether the design system already has one.
exampleTrans: 新建按钮之前，先看看设计系统里是不是已经有了。

name: hierarchy
example: The page lacks hierarchy, so the main action gets lost among the links.
exampleTrans: 页面缺乏层级感，主操作淹没在一堆链接里。

name: typography
trans: n. 字体排印；文字排版
example: Clean typography makes the dashboard much easier to scan.
exampleTrans: 清晰的文字排版让仪表盘更容易浏览。

name: contrast
example: The gray text on white doesn't have enough contrast for accessibility.
exampleTrans: 白底上的灰色文字对比度不够，不满足无障碍要求。

name: consistent
example: Keep the icon style consistent across the app, either all outline or all filled.
exampleTrans: 整个应用的图标风格要保持一致，要么全线性，要么全面性。

name: breakpoint
example: At the tablet breakpoint the sidebar collapses into a hamburger menu.
exampleTrans: 在平板断点下，侧边栏会收起成汉堡菜单。

name: responsive
trans: adj. 响应式的；自适应的
example: We need a responsive version of the pricing page by Friday.
exampleTrans: 周五前我们需要定价页的响应式版本。

name: auto layout
example: Use auto layout on the button so it grows with the label text.
exampleTrans: 按钮要用自动布局，这样它能随文字长度自动变宽。

name: variant
trans: n. 变体（组件的不同样式或状态）
example: The button component has variants for size, style and state.
exampleTrans: 按钮组件有尺寸、样式和状态等不同变体。

name: hover state
example: Don't forget to design a hover state for every clickable row.
exampleTrans: 别忘了给每一行可点击的列表设计悬停状态。

name: disabled
example: The submit button stays disabled until all required fields are filled.
exampleTrans: 在所有必填项填完之前，提交按钮保持禁用状态。

name: button
example: Make the primary button full width on mobile so it's easier to tap.
exampleTrans: 移动端主按钮做成通栏宽度，更容易点击。

name: dropdown
example: With only three options, radio buttons work better than a dropdown here.
exampleTrans: 只有三个选项的话，这里用单选按钮比下拉框更好。

name: toggle
example: Use a toggle for settings that take effect immediately without saving.
exampleTrans: 无需保存就立即生效的设置项用开关控件。

name: palette
example: Our palette has one brand blue, five neutrals and four semantic colors.
exampleTrans: 我们的配色方案包括一个品牌蓝、五个中性色和四个语义色。

name: gradient
example: The subtle gradient on the header adds depth without feeling flashy.
exampleTrans: 页头上微妙的渐变增加了层次感，又不显得花哨。

name: opacity
example: Set the overlay to black at sixty percent opacity.
exampleTrans: 把遮罩设置成百分之六十不透明度的黑色。

name: font weight
example: Use a heavier font weight for the price so it stands out.
exampleTrans: 价格用更粗的字重，让它更突出。

name: line height
example: Body text should have a line height of about one and a half.
exampleTrans: 正文的行高应该在一点五倍左右。

name: font size
example: The font size on mobile is too small; bump it up to sixteen.
exampleTrans: 移动端字号太小了，调大到十六。

name: spec
trans: n. 设计规范；标注说明
example: I've added the spec for the new modal to the handoff page.
exampleTrans: 我已经把新弹窗的设计标注加到交付页里了。

name: handoff
example: Let's walk the developers through the screens during handoff tomorrow.
exampleTrans: 明天交付时我们给开发同学逐页讲解一下。

name: export
example: Export the icons as SVG and the photos as compressed JPEGs.
exampleTrans: 图标导出为 SVG，照片导出为压缩过的 JPEG。

name: asset
example: All final assets are in the shared folder, named by screen.
exampleTrans: 所有最终切图都在共享文件夹里，按页面命名。

name: icon
example: This icon is ambiguous, so let's add a text label next to it.
exampleTrans: 这个图标含义不明确，旁边加个文字标签吧。

name: visual hierarchy
example: Size and color are the strongest tools for building visual hierarchy.
exampleTrans: 尺寸和颜色是建立视觉层级最有力的手段。

name: whitespace
example: Don't be afraid of whitespace; it makes the content feel premium.
exampleTrans: 别害怕留白，它能让内容显得更高级。

name: artboard
example: Duplicate the artboard and try a version with a darker header.
exampleTrans: 复制一下画板，试试页头更深的版本。

name: canvas
example: The canvas is getting messy, so let's move old explorations to another page.
exampleTrans: 画布越来越乱了，把旧的探索稿移到另一个页面吧。

name: viewport
example: The modal should never be taller than the viewport.
exampleTrans: 弹窗的高度永远不应该超过视口。

name: container
example: The content container has a maximum width of twelve hundred pixels.
exampleTrans: 内容容器的最大宽度是一千二百像素。

name: constraint
example: Set the constraints so the close icon stays pinned to the top right.
exampleTrans: 设置好约束，让关闭图标始终固定在右上角。

name: baseline grid
example: Align all text to a four-pixel baseline grid for a tidy rhythm.
exampleTrans: 所有文字都对齐到四像素的基线网格上，节奏更整齐。

name: eight-point grid
example: We follow an eight-point grid, so spacing values are multiples of eight.
exampleTrans: 我们遵循八点网格系统，所以间距都是八的倍数。

name: stack
example: On mobile, stack the two columns vertically instead of shrinking them.
exampleTrans: 在移动端，把两栏改为纵向堆叠。

name: offset
example: Give the shadow a two-pixel vertical offset and eight-pixel blur.
exampleTrans: 给阴影设置两像素的垂直偏移和八像素的模糊。

name: density
example: Offer a compact density option for power users with large tables.
exampleTrans: 为使用大表格的资深用户提供紧凑密度选项。

name: above the fold
trans: phr. 首屏；无需滚动即可见的区域
example: Keep the sign-up button above the fold on common laptop screens.
exampleTrans: 在常见笔记本屏幕上，让注册按钮保持在首屏内。

name: hero section
example: The hero section has a bold headline, a short subtitle and one button.
exampleTrans: 首屏主视觉区有一个醒目的标题、简短的副标题和一个按钮。

name: sticky
trans: adj. 吸顶的；固定悬浮的
example: Make the header sticky so navigation is always within reach.
exampleTrans: 把页头做成吸顶的，让导航始终触手可及。

name: scroll
example: The table should scroll horizontally on small screens.
exampleTrans: 在小屏幕上表格应该可以横向滚动。

name: overflow
example: Long names overflow the card, so we need a rule for truncation.
exampleTrans: 长名字会溢出卡片，我们需要一个截断规则。

name: truncate
example: Truncate the title after two lines and add an ellipsis.
exampleTrans: 标题超过两行就截断，并加上省略号。

name: left-aligned
example: Long paragraphs should always be left-aligned, not centered on the page.
exampleTrans: 长段落应该左对齐，而不是居中。

name: distribute
example: Select the icons and distribute them horizontally with equal spacing.
exampleTrans: 选中这些图标，水平方向等间距分布。

name: safe area
example: Keep the bottom buttons inside the safe area on newer phones.
exampleTrans: 在较新的手机上，底部按钮要保持在安全区域内。

name: mobile-first
example: We took a mobile-first approach and scaled up to desktop.
exampleTrans: 我们采用移动优先的方法，再扩展到桌面端。

name: column
example: On desktop the form spans eight columns and stays centered.
exampleTrans: 在桌面端，表单占八列并保持居中。

name: gutter
example: We use twenty-four pixel gutters on desktop and sixteen on mobile.
exampleTrans: 桌面端栏间距是二十四像素，移动端是十六像素。

name: frame
example: Put each screen in its own frame and name it clearly.
exampleTrans: 每个页面放在单独的画框里，并清晰命名。

name: layer
example: Please clean up the layer names before sharing the file.
exampleTrans: 分享文件之前请整理一下图层命名。

name: mockup
example: I'll share the high-fidelity mockups with the client on Monday.
exampleTrans: 我周一会把高保真视觉稿发给客户。

name: wireframe
example: Let's agree on the wireframes before we spend time on visual details.
exampleTrans: 我们先把线框图定下来，再去打磨视觉细节。

name: prototype
example: I linked the screens into a clickable prototype for the demo.
exampleTrans: 我把这些页面连成了可点击的原型用于演示。

name: modal
example: Avoid stacking a second modal on top of an open one.
exampleTrans: 避免在已打开的弹窗上再叠一个弹窗。

name: tooltip
trans: n. 工具提示；气泡提示
example: Show a tooltip on hover to explain what this metric means.
exampleTrans: 鼠标悬停时显示工具提示，解释这个指标的含义。

name: card
example: Each product card shows an image, a title and a price.
exampleTrans: 每张商品卡片展示一张图片、一个标题和一个价格。

name: design token
trans: n. 设计令牌（设计变量）
example: Use design tokens for colors instead of hard-coding hex values.
exampleTrans: 颜色要用设计令牌，而不是写死十六进制色值。

name: token
example: The spacing token for this gap should be space-four, not a custom value.
exampleTrans: 这个间隙应该用 space-four 这个间距变量，而不是自定义数值。

name: instance
example: Changes to the main component will update every instance automatically.
exampleTrans: 修改主组件会自动更新所有实例。

name: library
example: Publish the library so other teams can pull in the updated icons.
exampleTrans: 发布组件库，让其他团队能用上更新后的图标。

name: redline
example: Developers asked for redlines showing every margin on the checkout page.
exampleTrans: 开发同学要求提供结算页上标出所有边距的标注图。

name: annotation
example: Add annotations to explain how the list behaves when it's empty.
exampleTrans: 加上注释说明列表为空时的表现。

name: polish
example: The flow works, but the screens still need a round of polish.
exampleTrans: 流程是通的，但页面还需要再打磨一轮。

name: cluttered
example: The toolbar feels cluttered, so let's move rare actions into a menu.
exampleTrans: 工具栏显得很杂乱，把不常用的操作收进菜单吧。

name: balance
example: The large image on the left needs something on the right for balance.
exampleTrans: 左侧的大图需要右边有些元素来取得平衡。

name: color scheme
example: The new color scheme feels warmer and fits the brand much better.
exampleTrans: 新的配色方案感觉更温暖，也更契合品牌。

name: accent color
example: Reserve the accent color for links and the main call to action.
exampleTrans: 强调色只留给链接和主要行动按钮使用。

name: primary color
example: Our primary color fails contrast on white, so we darkened it slightly.
exampleTrans: 我们的主色在白底上对比度不达标，所以稍微加深了一点。

name: neutral
example: Most of the interface uses neutrals so the content can stand out.
exampleTrans: 界面大部分用中性色，让内容更突出。

name: saturation
example: Lower the saturation of the background illustration so it doesn't compete.
exampleTrans: 降低背景插画的饱和度，免得它抢视觉焦点。

name: hue
example: Shift the hue slightly toward blue to make the green feel cooler.
exampleTrans: 把色相稍微往蓝偏一点，让这个绿色感觉更冷。

name: tint
example: Use a light tint of the brand color for the selected row background.
exampleTrans: 选中行的背景用品牌色的浅色调。

name: shade
example: We need a darker shade of red for the pressed state.
exampleTrans: 按下状态需要一个更深的红色色阶。

name: drop shadow
example: Soften the drop shadow; right now the card looks like it's floating away.
exampleTrans: 把投影弱化一些，现在卡片看起来像要飘走了。

name: shadow
example: Use one shadow style for cards and a stronger one for menus.
exampleTrans: 卡片用一种阴影样式，菜单用更强一点的阴影。

name: border
example: Remove the border and rely on the background color to separate sections.
exampleTrans: 去掉边框，用背景色来区分各个区块。

name: border radius
example: Buttons use an eight-pixel border radius, while cards use twelve.
exampleTrans: 按钮使用八像素的圆角，卡片使用十二像素。

name: corner radius
example: The corner radius on the image doesn't match the card it sits in.
exampleTrans: 图片的圆角和它所在卡片的圆角不一致。

name: stroke
example: All icons use a one-and-a-half pixel stroke with rounded ends.
exampleTrans: 所有图标都用一点五像素、圆头端点的描边。

name: fill
example: Change the fill to the surface color so it works in dark mode.
exampleTrans: 把填充色改成表面色，这样在深色模式下也适用。

name: dark mode
example: Every screen needs to be checked in dark mode before release.
exampleTrans: 发布前每个页面都要在深色模式下检查一遍。

name: light mode
example: The illustration looks great in light mode but disappears on dark backgrounds.
exampleTrans: 这幅插画在浅色模式下很好看，但在深色背景上就看不见了。

name: theme
example: Switching the theme should only swap tokens, not the layout.
exampleTrans: 切换主题应该只替换变量，不改变布局。

name: checkbox
example: Use a checkbox when users can select more than one option.
exampleTrans: 当用户可以选多个选项时使用复选框。

name: radio button
example: Radio buttons should be stacked vertically for easier scanning.
exampleTrans: 单选按钮应该竖向排列，更方便浏览。

name: input field
example: Make the input field taller so it matches the button next to it.
exampleTrans: 把输入框加高，和旁边的按钮保持一致。

name: text field
example: The text field shows a red border and message when validation fails.
exampleTrans: 校验失败时，文本框会显示红色边框和提示信息。

name: placeholder
example: Don't use placeholder text as a label, because it disappears on typing.
exampleTrans: 不要把占位文字当标签用，因为一输入它就消失了。

name: label
example: Keep button labels short and start them with a verb.
exampleTrans: 按钮文字要简短，并以动词开头。

name: heading
example: Each section heading should be one size larger than the body text.
exampleTrans: 每个区块标题应该比正文大一个字号。

name: body text
example: Body text is sixteen pixels regular with a twenty-four pixel line height.
exampleTrans: 正文是十六像素常规字重，行高二十四像素。

name: caption
example: Put the photo credit in a small caption below the image.
exampleTrans: 把图片来源放在图片下方的小号说明文字里。

name: font
example: Make sure the font is licensed for web and app use.
exampleTrans: 确认这款字体已获得网页和应用的使用授权。

name: typeface
example: We chose a geometric typeface to give the brand a modern feel.
exampleTrans: 我们选了一款几何风格的字体，给品牌带来现代感。

name: letter spacing
example: Increase the letter spacing slightly on uppercase labels.
exampleTrans: 全大写的标签要稍微加大字间距。

name: kerning
trans: n. 字偶间距；字距微调
example: The kerning in the logo looks off between the A and the V.
exampleTrans: 标志里 A 和 V 之间的字距看起来不太对。

name: type scale
example: Our type scale has eight steps, from caption to display.
exampleTrans: 我们的字号层级有八级，从说明文字到展示大标题。

name: text style
example: Apply the shared text style instead of setting the font manually.
exampleTrans: 请套用共享文字样式，而不是手动设置字体。

name: legibility
example: Thin weights hurt legibility at small sizes, especially on low-end screens.
exampleTrans: 细字重在小字号下会降低清晰度，在低端屏幕上尤其明显。

name: readability
example: Shorter line lengths will improve the readability of long articles.
exampleTrans: 缩短每行的长度能提升长文章的可读性。

name: serif
example: A serif for headlines gives the magazine a more editorial look.
exampleTrans: 标题用衬线字体会让杂志更有编辑出版的质感。

name: sans serif
example: We use a sans serif for the interface because it's clear at small sizes.
exampleTrans: 界面用无衬线字体，因为小字号下也很清晰。

name: bold
example: Only bold the key numbers, not the whole sentence.
exampleTrans: 只把关键数字加粗，不要整句加粗。

name: tab
example: The active tab gets an underline and the brand color.
exampleTrans: 当前选中的标签页加下划线并使用品牌色。

name: navigation
example: The top navigation has too many items, so let's group a few.
exampleTrans: 顶部导航项太多了，我们把其中几个归一下组。

name: header
example: Keep the header height at sixty-four pixels across all pages.
exampleTrans: 所有页面的页头高度都保持六十四像素。

name: footer
example: The footer links should use the same text style as the captions.
exampleTrans: 页脚的链接应该和说明文字使用相同的文字样式。

name: sidebar
example: The sidebar can be collapsed to show only icons.
exampleTrans: 侧边栏可以收起，只显示图标。

name: menu
example: Group destructive actions at the bottom of the menu, separated by a divider.
exampleTrans: 把危险操作放在菜单底部，用分割线隔开。

name: search bar
example: Place the search bar in the header so it's reachable from every page.
exampleTrans: 把搜索栏放在页头，这样每个页面都能用到。

name: badge
example: A red badge on the bell icon shows the number of unread alerts.
exampleTrans: 铃铛图标上的红色角标显示未读提醒数量。

name: tag
example: Each article can have up to three tags shown under the title.
exampleTrans: 每篇文章最多可以在标题下方显示三个标签。

name: chip
trans: n. 纸片标签；筛选标签
example: Selected filters appear as chips that can be removed with one tap.
exampleTrans: 选中的筛选条件以标签形式显示，点一下就能移除。

name: avatar
example: If there's no photo, show the user's initials inside the avatar.
exampleTrans: 如果没有照片，就在头像里显示用户名字的首字母。

name: illustration
example: The empty state needs a friendly illustration and one clear action.
exampleTrans: 空状态需要一幅友好的插画和一个明确的操作。

name: thumbnail
example: Video thumbnails should all use a sixteen by nine aspect ratio.
exampleTrans: 视频缩略图统一使用十六比九的宽高比。

name: banner
example: Show a warning banner at the top when the subscription is about to expire.
exampleTrans: 订阅即将到期时，在顶部显示一条警告横幅。

name: toast
example: After saving, show a short toast that disappears after three seconds.
exampleTrans: 保存后显示一条三秒后自动消失的轻提示。

name: dialog
example: The confirmation dialog should clearly say what will be deleted.
exampleTrans: 确认对话框应该清楚说明将要删除什么。

name: bottom sheet
example: On mobile, the filter options slide up in a bottom sheet.
exampleTrans: 在移动端，筛选选项会从底部面板中滑出。

name: accordion
example: Use an accordion for the FAQ so the page doesn't get too long.
exampleTrans: 常见问题用折叠面板，免得页面太长。

name: breadcrumb
example: The breadcrumb helps users understand where they are in the catalog.
exampleTrans: 面包屑导航帮助用户了解自己在商品目录中的位置。

name: pagination
example: Replace the pagination with infinite scroll on the mobile feed.
exampleTrans: 移动端信息流里把分页器换成无限滚动。

name: carousel
example: Show part of the next slide so people know the carousel can scroll.
exampleTrans: 露出下一张的一部分，让人知道轮播图可以滑动。

name: slider
example: Use a slider for the price range, with input fields for exact values.
exampleTrans: 价格区间用滑块，并配上输入框填写精确数值。

name: stepper
example: The stepper at the top shows users they're on step two of four.
exampleTrans: 顶部的步骤条告诉用户现在处于四步中的第二步。

name: progress bar
example: Add a progress bar so users know how long the upload will take.
exampleTrans: 加一个进度条，让用户知道上传还需要多久。

name: spinner
trans: n. 加载转圈；加载图标
example: Show a spinner inside the button while the payment is processing.
exampleTrans: 支付处理期间在按钮内部显示加载转圈。

name: skeleton screen
example: A skeleton screen feels faster than a blank page with a spinner.
exampleTrans: 骨架屏比一个只有转圈的空白页感觉更快。

name: empty state
example: Design an empty state for when the user has no saved projects yet.
exampleTrans: 为用户还没有保存任何项目的情况设计一个空状态。

name: error state
example: Every form field needs an error state with a helpful message.
exampleTrans: 每个表单字段都需要一个带有帮助提示的错误状态。

name: loading state
example: What does the chart look like in its loading state?
exampleTrans: 这个图表在加载状态下是什么样子的？

name: focus state
example: Keyboard users rely on a visible focus state to know where they are.
exampleTrans: 键盘用户依赖明显的聚焦状态来判断自己的位置。

name: pressed state
example: The pressed state darkens the button by one shade.
exampleTrans: 按下状态会让按钮加深一个色阶。

name: active state
example: The active state of the menu item uses a filled background.
exampleTrans: 菜单项的激活状态使用填充背景。

name: selected
example: Selected rows get a light blue background and a checkmark.
exampleTrans: 选中的行会有浅蓝色背景和一个对勾。

name: default state
example: Start with the default state, then design hover, pressed and disabled.
exampleTrans: 先做默认状态，再设计悬停、按下和禁用状态。

name: call to action
trans: phr. 行动号召；主操作按钮
example: The call to action should be the most prominent element above the fold.
exampleTrans: 行动号召按钮应该是首屏中最醒目的元素。

name: primary button
example: There should be only one primary button on each screen.
exampleTrans: 每个页面上应该只有一个主按钮。

name: secondary button
example: Cancel is a secondary button, so it uses an outline style.
exampleTrans: 取消是次按钮，所以使用描边样式。

name: ghost button
trans: n. 幽灵按钮（透明描边按钮）
example: A ghost button works well on top of the dark hero image.
exampleTrans: 幽灵按钮放在深色首屏大图上效果很好。

name: segmented control
example: Use a segmented control to switch between day, week and month views.
exampleTrans: 用分段控件在日、周、月视图之间切换。

name: date picker
example: The date picker should highlight today and disable past dates.
exampleTrans: 日期选择器应该高亮今天并禁用过去的日期。

name: context menu
trans: n. 右键菜单；上下文菜单
example: Right-clicking a file opens a context menu with rename and delete.
exampleTrans: 右键点击文件会打开包含重命名和删除的上下文菜单。

name: hamburger menu
example: On mobile, secondary pages are tucked into the hamburger menu.
exampleTrans: 在移动端，次要页面都收进了汉堡菜单里。

name: tab bar
example: The tab bar at the bottom holds the app's five main sections.
exampleTrans: 底部标签栏承载应用的五个主要板块。

name: divider
example: A thin divider is enough to separate these two groups.
exampleTrans: 一条细分割线就足以区分这两组内容。

name: data table
example: The data table needs sortable headers and a sticky first column.
exampleTrans: 数据表格需要可排序的表头和固定的首列。

name: form
example: Split the long form into three short steps to reduce drop-off.
exampleTrans: 把长表单拆成三个简短的步骤，减少用户流失。

name: helper text
example: Add helper text under the password field explaining the requirements.
exampleTrans: 在密码框下面加辅助说明文字，解释密码要求。

name: validation
example: Inline validation tells users about mistakes before they hit submit.
exampleTrans: 实时校验能在用户提交之前就提示错误。

name: notification
example: Each notification shows an icon, a short message and a timestamp.
exampleTrans: 每条通知都显示一个图标、一条简短消息和一个时间戳。

name: overlay
example: Add a dark overlay on the photo so the white headline is readable.
exampleTrans: 在照片上加一层深色遮罩，让白色标题更易读。

name: blur
example: A background blur behind the menu keeps it readable over busy content.
exampleTrans: 菜单后面的背景模糊能让它在复杂内容上保持可读。

name: elevation
trans: n. 层级高度（阴影海拔）
example: Higher elevation means a stronger shadow, like for dialogs and menus.
exampleTrans: 层级越高阴影越强，比如对话框和菜单。

name: transparency
example: Too much transparency makes the navbar hard to read over photos.
exampleTrans: 透明度太高会让导航栏在照片上难以辨认。

name: swatch
example: I added swatches for the new status colors to the library.
exampleTrans: 我把新的状态色色板加进了组件库。

name: hex code
example: Can you send me the hex code for that shade of green?
exampleTrans: 能把那个绿色的十六进制色值发给我吗？

name: contrast ratio
example: Body text needs a contrast ratio of at least four and a half to one.
exampleTrans: 正文的对比度至少需要达到四点五比一。

name: accessibility
example: Accessibility isn't optional; check contrast and touch targets on every screen.
exampleTrans: 无障碍不是可有可无的，每个页面都要检查对比度和点击区域。

name: accessible
example: Is this color combination accessible for people with color blindness?
exampleTrans: 这个配色组合对色盲用户来说是无障碍的吗？

name: brand guidelines
example: The brand guidelines say the logo needs clear space on every side.
exampleTrans: 品牌规范规定标志四周都要留有安全空间。

name: style guide
trans: n. 风格指南；样式规范
example: The style guide covers colors, type, icons and tone of voice.
exampleTrans: 风格指南涵盖颜色、字体、图标和语言风格。

name: mood board
example: I put together a mood board to align on the visual direction first.
exampleTrans: 我做了一个情绪板，先就视觉方向达成一致。

name: visual language
example: The new feature should follow the same visual language as the rest of the app.
exampleTrans: 新功能应该沿用与应用其他部分相同的视觉语言。

name: look and feel
trans: phr. 外观与感觉；整体风格
example: The client likes the layout but wants a lighter look and feel.
exampleTrans: 客户喜欢这个布局，但希望整体风格更轻盈一些。

name: high fidelity
example: We'll move to high fidelity once the wireframes are approved.
exampleTrans: 线框图通过后我们再进入高保真阶段。

name: low fidelity
example: Low fidelity sketches are perfect for testing ideas quickly.
exampleTrans: 低保真草图非常适合快速验证想法。

name: main component
example: Edit the main component, not the instance, if the change should apply everywhere.
exampleTrans: 如果改动要全局生效，就修改主组件而不是实例。

name: override
example: Text overrides are fine, but don't override the button color.
exampleTrans: 改文字的覆盖没问题，但别覆盖按钮颜色。

name: detach
trans: v. 分离；解绑（组件实例）
example: Please don't detach instances, or they won't get library updates.
exampleTrans: 请不要解绑实例，否则它们收不到组件库的更新。

name: property
example: Add a boolean property to show or hide the icon in the button.
exampleTrans: 加一个布尔属性来控制按钮里图标的显示或隐藏。

name: naming convention
example: Follow the naming convention so developers can map layers to code.
exampleTrans: 遵循命名规范，方便开发把图层对应到代码。

name: pattern
trans: n. 模式；样式规律；图案
example: This is a common pattern, so reuse the existing list component.
exampleTrans: 这是一个常见模式，复用现有的列表组件就行。

name: template
example: Start every new project from the presentation template.
exampleTrans: 每个新项目都从演示模板开始做。

name: guideline
example: Our guidelines say icons and text should always be vertically centered.
exampleTrans: 我们的规范规定图标和文字必须始终垂直居中。

name: documentation
example: Good documentation explains when to use a component, not just how it looks.
exampleTrans: 好的文档会说明何时使用组件，而不仅仅是它的样子。

name: vector
example: Keep the logo as a vector so it stays sharp at any size.
exampleTrans: 标志要保持矢量格式，这样任何尺寸都很清晰。

name: scalable
trans: adj. 可缩放的；可扩展的
example: We need a scalable icon system that works from sixteen to forty-eight pixels.
exampleTrans: 我们需要一套可缩放的图标体系，适用于十六到四十八像素。

name: resolution
example: Export the banner at double resolution for high-density screens.
exampleTrans: 横幅按两倍分辨率导出，以适配高密度屏幕。

name: pixel
example: The icon is one pixel off center, and it's noticeable at this size.
exampleTrans: 这个图标偏离中心一个像素，在这个尺寸下很明显。

name: pixel-perfect
example: The build is close, but it's not pixel-perfect yet.
exampleTrans: 开发实现已经很接近了，但还没做到像素级还原。

name: aspect ratio
example: Lock the aspect ratio when resizing so the photo doesn't stretch.
exampleTrans: 调整尺寸时锁定宽高比，免得照片被拉伸。

name: crop
example: Crop the photo tighter so the person's face is the focal point.
exampleTrans: 照片再裁紧一些，让人物的脸成为视觉焦点。

name: resize
example: The card should resize smoothly as the window gets narrower.
exampleTrans: 窗口变窄时，卡片应该平滑地调整尺寸。

name: scale
example: Scale the illustration down so it doesn't push the button below the fold.
exampleTrans: 把插画缩小一点，免得它把按钮挤到首屏以下。

name: mask
example: Use a circular mask to crop the profile photos.
exampleTrans: 用圆形蒙版来裁切头像照片。

name: group
example: Group the icon and label together so they move as one.
exampleTrans: 把图标和文字编成一组，让它们一起移动。

name: inspect
example: Developers can inspect any layer to get its exact spacing and color.
exampleTrans: 开发可以查看任意图层，获取准确的间距和颜色。

name: iteration
example: This is the third iteration, and the hierarchy is much clearer now.
exampleTrans: 这是第三次迭代，现在的层级清晰多了。

name: iterate
example: Let's ship this version and iterate based on what we see.
exampleTrans: 我们先上线这个版本，再根据观察结果迭代。

name: version history
example: You can restore the old layout from the version history.
exampleTrans: 你可以从版本历史里恢复旧的布局。

name: sign-off
trans: n. 签字确认；最终批准
example: We need sign-off from the brand team before the launch.
exampleTrans: 上线前我们需要品牌团队的最终确认。

name: deliverable
example: The main deliverables are the mockups, the prototype and the spec.
exampleTrans: 主要交付物是视觉稿、原型和设计规范。

name: source file
example: Please link the source file in the ticket so others can find it.
exampleTrans: 请在工单里附上源文件链接，方便其他人查找。

name: edge case
trans: n. 边界情况；极端情况
example: What happens in the edge case where the username is fifty characters long?
exampleTrans: 用户名长达五十个字符这种边界情况下会怎么显示？

name: implementation
example: I reviewed the implementation and found a few spacing issues.
exampleTrans: 我检查了开发实现，发现了几处间距问题。

name: design review
example: Bring two or three options to the design review on Thursday.
exampleTrans: 周四的设计评审请带两到三个方案。

name: feedback
example: Thanks for the feedback, I'll update the colors and share again.
exampleTrans: 谢谢反馈，我会更新颜色后再分享一次。

name: rationale
example: Explain the rationale behind moving the button to the top right.
exampleTrans: 解释一下把按钮移到右上角的理由。

name: design direction
example: We explored two design directions: one minimal and one more playful.
exampleTrans: 我们探索了两个设计方向：一个极简，一个更活泼。

name: emphasis
example: Too many bold words means nothing has emphasis anymore.
exampleTrans: 加粗的词太多，等于没有重点了。

name: focal point
example: The product photo should be the focal point of this card.
exampleTrans: 商品图应该是这张卡片的视觉焦点。

name: visual weight
example: The dark footer has too much visual weight compared to the content.
exampleTrans: 深色页脚相对于内容来说视觉重量太大了。

name: proportion
example: The image and text columns feel out of proportion on wide screens.
exampleTrans: 在宽屏上，图片栏和文字栏的比例显得失调。

name: consistency
example: Consistency across platforms matters more than small local tweaks.
exampleTrans: 跨平台的一致性比局部的小调整更重要。

name: clean
example: The new version looks much cleaner without all those borders.
exampleTrans: 去掉那些边框后，新版本看起来干净多了。

name: minimal
example: Keep the onboarding screens minimal, with one idea per screen.
exampleTrans: 引导页保持极简，每页只讲一个点。

name: busy
trans: adj. 繁杂的；元素过多的
example: The background pattern makes the whole page look too busy.
exampleTrans: 背景图案让整个页面看起来太繁杂了。

name: cramped
example: The table rows feel cramped, so let's increase the row height.
exampleTrans: 表格行显得很拥挤，我们把行高调大一些。

name: subtle
example: Keep the animation subtle so it doesn't distract from the content.
exampleTrans: 动画要保持低调，免得分散对内容的注意力。

name: cohesive
trans: adj. 有凝聚力的；统一协调的
example: The icons, illustrations and photos need to feel like a cohesive set.
exampleTrans: 图标、插画和照片需要看起来是一套协调统一的整体。

name: playful
example: The rounded shapes and bright colors give the app a playful tone.
exampleTrans: 圆润的形状和明亮的色彩给应用带来活泼的调性。

name: outdated
example: Heavy gradients and bevels make the old dashboard look outdated.
exampleTrans: 厚重的渐变和斜面效果让旧版仪表盘显得过时。

name: intuitive
example: The drag handle makes reordering items in the list feel intuitive.
exampleTrans: 拖拽手柄让重新排序变得很直观。

name: distracting
example: The looping animation in the corner is distracting while reading.
exampleTrans: 角落里循环播放的动画在阅读时很分散注意力。

name: misaligned
example: The checkbox is slightly misaligned with the first line of text.
exampleTrans: 复选框和第一行文字略微没有对齐。

name: off-brand
trans: adj. 不符合品牌调性的
example: That neon green feels off-brand for a banking app.
exampleTrans: 那个荧光绿对于银行类应用来说不符合品牌调性。

name: tweak
example: I just need to tweak the spacing before I send it over.
exampleTrans: 发过去之前我只需要微调一下间距。

name: refine
example: Let's refine the icon set so the line weights are all the same.
exampleTrans: 我们来精修一下这套图标，让线条粗细都统一。

name: pop
example: Can we make the sale price pop a bit more?
exampleTrans: 能让促销价格再显眼一点吗？

name: breathing room
trans: n. 呼吸空间；留白空间
example: Give the headline more breathing room above and below.
exampleTrans: 给标题上下多留一些呼吸空间。

name: scannable
example: Use short headings and bullets to make the page more scannable.
exampleTrans: 用简短的标题和列表符号让页面更便于快速浏览。

name: ellipsis
example: Show the full name in a tooltip when it's cut off with an ellipsis.
exampleTrans: 名字被省略号截断时，在工具提示里显示全名。

name: uppercase
example: Small uppercase labels need extra letter spacing to stay readable.
exampleTrans: 小号的大写标签需要额外的字间距才能保持易读。

name: all caps
example: Don't set long headlines in all caps; they become hard to read.
exampleTrans: 长标题不要全大写，会变得难以阅读。

name: font family
example: We use one font family with four weights across the product.
exampleTrans: 整个产品只用一个字体家族的四种字重。

name: line length
example: Keep the line length around sixty to seventy-five characters.
exampleTrans: 把行长控制在六十到七十五个字符左右。

name: microcopy
example: Good microcopy on the error message can calm frustrated users.
exampleTrans: 错误提示里写得好的微文案能安抚受挫的用户。

name: headline
example: The headline wraps awkwardly on mobile, so let's shorten it.
exampleTrans: 标题在移动端换行很别扭，我们缩短一下。

name: monochrome
example: A monochrome icon set keeps the toolbar calm and focused.
exampleTrans: 单色图标集让工具栏保持沉稳、聚焦。

name: vibrant
trans: adj. 鲜艳的；充满活力的
example: The marketing site uses more vibrant colors than the product.
exampleTrans: 营销网站使用的颜色比产品本身更鲜艳。

name: muted
example: Use muted tones for backgrounds and save bright colors for actions.
exampleTrans: 背景用低饱和的柔和色调，鲜艳颜色留给操作按钮。

name: semantic color
example: Semantic colors like red and green should only signal status.
exampleTrans: 红色和绿色这类语义色只应用来表示状态。

name: flat design
example: Flat design is clean, but we need some depth to show clickable areas.
exampleTrans: 扁平化设计很干净，但我们需要一些层次感来表示可点击区域。

name: outline
example: Use outline icons in the navigation and filled ones for the selected item.
exampleTrans: 导航中使用线性图标，选中项使用面性图标。

name: filled
trans: adj. 填充的；面性的（图标）
example: The filled heart shows that the item is already in favorites.
exampleTrans: 实心的爱心表示该商品已在收藏中。

name: interaction
example: Can you prototype the interaction for swiping to delete?
exampleTrans: 你能把滑动删除的交互做成原型吗？

name: animation
example: The page transition animation is too slow; try two hundred milliseconds.
exampleTrans: 页面切换动画太慢了，试试两百毫秒。

name: transition
example: Use a fade transition when switching between tabs.
exampleTrans: 切换标签页时使用淡入淡出的过渡效果。

name: easing
example: Use ease-out easing so the menu slows down as it opens.
exampleTrans: 使用缓出曲线，让菜单展开时逐渐减速。

name: motion
example: Our motion guidelines define three standard durations and curves.
exampleTrans: 我们的动效规范定义了三种标准时长和曲线。

name: tap target
trans: n. 点击区域；触控目标
example: The close icon is small, but its tap target should be forty-four pixels.
exampleTrans: 关闭图标很小，但它的点击区域应该是四十四像素。

name: drag and drop
example: Users can drag and drop files anywhere on the upload area.
exampleTrans: 用户可以把文件拖放到上传区域的任意位置。

name: icon set
example: Draw the new icon in the same style as the rest of the icon set.
exampleTrans: 新图标要按照整套图标集的风格来画。

name: variable
example: Bind the card background to a color variable so it switches with the theme.
exampleTrans: 把卡片背景绑定到颜色变量上，让它随主题切换。

name: visual design
example: The visual design is done; now we're preparing the specs.
exampleTrans: 视觉设计已经完成，现在我们在准备标注。

name: explore
example: Let's explore a version where the filters live in a sidebar.
exampleTrans: 我们探索一个把筛选项放在侧边栏的版本。

name: brightness
example: Lower the brightness of the background image so the text stands out.
exampleTrans: 把背景图的亮度调低一些，让文字更突出。

name: lightness
trans: n. 明度（HSL 中的 L）
example: In HSL, we keep the hue and only change the lightness for hover states.
exampleTrans: 在 HSL 里我们保持色相不变，只调整明度来做悬停态。

name: value
trans: n. 明度（色彩明暗程度）
example: Squint at the screen to check the value contrast between the cards and the page.
exampleTrans: 眯眼看屏幕，检查卡片和页面之间的明度对比。

name: tone
trans: n. 色调（加灰后的颜色）
example: A muted tone of blue works better for a finance dashboard.
exampleTrans: 偏灰的蓝色调更适合金融看板。

name: chroma
example: Reduce the chroma of the secondary colors so the brand color leads.
exampleTrans: 降低辅助色的彩度，让品牌色更突出。

name: luminance
trans: n. 亮度（感知亮度，用于计算对比度）
example: Contrast ratio is calculated from the relative luminance of two colors.
exampleTrans: 对比度是根据两种颜色的相对亮度计算出来的。

name: vibrance
example: Boost the vibrance a little so the product photos look less flat.
exampleTrans: 稍微提高自然饱和度，让商品图不那么灰。

name: desaturate
example: Desaturate the disabled buttons so users know they can't click them.
exampleTrans: 把禁用按钮去色，让用户知道它们不能点。

name: saturated
example: These saturated colors feel too loud for a reading app.
exampleTrans: 这些高饱和的颜色对阅读类应用来说太刺眼了。

name: complementary color
example: Orange is the complementary color of blue, so the button really pops.
exampleTrans: 橙色是蓝色的互补色，所以按钮非常醒目。

name: analogous colors
example: An analogous color scheme of greens and teals feels calm and natural.
exampleTrans: 绿色和青色的类似色搭配让人感觉平静自然。

name: monochromatic
example: The settings page uses a monochromatic palette with one accent.
exampleTrans: 设置页使用同色系配色，只有一个强调色。

name: color wheel
example: Pick the secondary color from the opposite side of the color wheel.
exampleTrans: 从色轮的对面挑选辅助色。

name: color temperature
example: The photos have different color temperatures, so the page looks inconsistent.
exampleTrans: 这些照片色温不一样，页面看起来不统一。

name: warm color
example: Warm colors like red and orange draw attention to promotions.
exampleTrans: 红、橙这类暖色能把注意力引向促销信息。

name: cool color
example: Cool colors make the dashboard feel more professional and calm.
exampleTrans: 冷色让看板显得更专业、更冷静。

name: neutral color
example: Most of the interface should use neutral colors, with color only for actions.
exampleTrans: 界面大部分应使用中性色，只有操作用彩色。

name: color harmony
trans: n. 色彩和谐；配色协调
example: The illustrations break the color harmony of the landing page.
exampleTrans: 这些插画破坏了落地页的配色协调。

name: color picker
example: Use the color picker to grab the exact blue from the logo.
exampleTrans: 用取色器从 logo 上取出准确的蓝色。

name: eyedropper
example: Select the eyedropper and click the image to sample its color.
exampleTrans: 选择吸管工具，点击图片取样颜色。

name: RGB
trans: n. RGB 色彩模式（红绿蓝）
example: Screens display colors in RGB, so convert the print colors first.
exampleTrans: 屏幕用 RGB 显示颜色，所以先把印刷色转换一下。

name: HSL
trans: n. HSL 色彩模型（色相、饱和度、明度）
example: Defining tokens in HSL makes it easy to create lighter and darker shades.
exampleTrans: 用 HSL 定义色彩变量，方便生成更浅或更深的颜色。

name: CMYK
trans: n. CMYK 印刷色彩模式
example: Send the brochure to the printer in CMYK.
exampleTrans: 把宣传册以 CMYK 模式发给印刷厂。

name: color blindness
example: Don't rely on red and green alone; consider users with color blindness.
exampleTrans: 不要只靠红绿区分，要考虑色觉障碍用户。

name: highlight
example: Add a subtle highlight on the top edge to make the button feel raised.
exampleTrans: 在按钮上沿加一道淡淡的高光，让它有凸起感。

name: midtone
example: Brighten the midtones without blowing out the highlights.
exampleTrans: 提亮中间调，同时别让高光过曝。

name: blend mode
example: Set the texture layer's blend mode to multiply.
exampleTrans: 把纹理图层的混合模式设为正片叠底。

name: tonal
example: Use tonal variations of the brand color for the chart series.
exampleTrans: 图表系列用品牌色的不同色调。

name: leading
example: Increase the leading so long paragraphs are easier to read.
exampleTrans: 加大行距，让长段落更易读。

name: tracking
trans: n. 字距（整体字母间距）
example: Tracking controls the overall spacing across an entire word.
exampleTrans: 字距调整控制整个单词中字符间的总体间距。

name: baseline
example: The icon sits slightly below the text baseline.
exampleTrans: 图标比文字基线略低。

name: sans-serif
example: We use a sans-serif typeface for the interface and a serif for articles.
exampleTrans: 界面用无衬线字体，文章用衬线字体。

name: x-height
trans: n. x 字高（小写字母主体高度）
example: Fonts with a large x-height stay legible at small sizes.
exampleTrans: x 字高大的字体在小字号下依然清晰。

name: ascender
trans: n. 上伸部（如 b、d、h 的上部）
example: Leave enough line height so ascenders don't touch the line above.
exampleTrans: 留足行高，避免上伸部碰到上一行。

name: descender
trans: n. 下伸部（如 g、p、y 的下部）
example: The descenders are cut off in the button label.
exampleTrans: 按钮文字的下伸部被裁掉了。

name: ligature
example: The ligature combines these letters into one refined typographic glyph.
exampleTrans: 连字把这些字母组合成一个精致的排版字形。

name: italic
example: Use italic for captions, not for whole paragraphs.
exampleTrans: 说明文字用斜体，不要整段用斜体。

name: title case
trans: n. 标题大小写（每个主要单词首字母大写）
example: Buttons use sentence case, while page titles use title case.
exampleTrans: 按钮用句首大写，页面标题用标题大小写。

name: sentence case
trans: n. 句首大写（只有第一个词首字母大写）
example: Write menu items in sentence case for a friendlier tone.
exampleTrans: 菜单项用句首大写，语气更亲切。

name: orphan
trans: n. 孤行（段落末行只剩一个词）
example: Adjust the width to avoid an orphan at the end of the paragraph.
exampleTrans: 调整宽度，避免段尾出现孤字。

name: widow
trans: n. 寡行（段落最后一行落到下一栏 / 页）
example: There's a widow at the top of the second column.
exampleTrans: 第二栏顶部出现了寡行。

name: glyph
example: This font doesn't include the glyph for the euro sign.
exampleTrans: 这个字体没有欧元符号的字形。

name: text wrap
example: Allow text wrap in the table cells instead of truncating.
exampleTrans: 表格单元格允许换行，而不是截断。

name: optical alignment
trans: n. 视觉对齐（按视觉而非数值对齐）
example: The play icon needs optical alignment because the triangle looks off-center.
exampleTrans: 播放图标需要视觉对齐，因为三角形看起来偏了。

name: negative space
example: Use negative space to separate groups instead of adding more lines.
exampleTrans: 用留白区分分组，而不是加更多分割线。

name: proximity
example: By the principle of proximity, the label should sit closer to its field.
exampleTrans: 按照接近原则，标签应该离它的输入框更近。

name: repetition
example: Repetition of the same card style makes the page feel consistent.
exampleTrans: 重复使用同一种卡片样式，让页面更统一。

name: symmetry
example: The hero section feels static because of strict symmetry.
exampleTrans: 首屏因为严格对称显得呆板。

name: asymmetry
example: A little asymmetry adds energy to the layout.
exampleTrans: 适度的不对称能让版式更有活力。

name: rhythm
example: Repeated spacing creates a steady visual rhythm across the page.
exampleTrans: 重复的间距在整个页面形成稳定的视觉节奏。

name: grid system
example: Our grid system uses 12 columns on desktop and 4 on mobile.
exampleTrans: 我们的栅格系统桌面端 12 栏，移动端 4 栏。

name: depth
example: Shadows and blur add depth to the floating panel.
exampleTrans: 阴影和模糊让浮层更有层次感。

name: iconography
trans: n. 图标体系；图标设计
example: Keep the iconography consistent: same stroke width and corner style.
exampleTrans: 保持图标体系一致：相同的线宽和圆角风格。

name: skeuomorphism
example: Skeuomorphism makes this control resemble a physical rotary dial.
exampleTrans: 拟物化让这个控件看起来像实体旋钮。

name: glassmorphism
example: Glassmorphism looks nice, but check the text contrast on blurred backgrounds.
exampleTrans: 毛玻璃风格好看，但要检查模糊背景上的文字对比度。

name: hero image
trans: n. 首屏大图；主视觉图
example: Replace the stock photo in the hero image with a product shot.
exampleTrans: 把首屏大图里的图库照片换成产品图。

name: boolean operation
trans: n. 布尔运算（合并、减去、相交等）
example: Use a boolean operation to cut the notch out of the shape.
exampleTrans: 用布尔运算从形状里减去缺口。

name: pen tool
example: Redraw the logo with the pen tool so it scales cleanly.
exampleTrans: 用钢笔工具重绘 logo，放大时才清晰。

name: bounding box
example: The icon's bounding box should be 24 by 24.
exampleTrans: 图标的边界框应该是 24×24。

name: nudge
trans: v. 微调位置（用方向键移动）
example: Nudge the label two pixels to the right.
exampleTrans: 把标签向右微调两个像素。

name: snap
trans: v. 吸附（对齐到网格或其他元素）
example: Turn on snap to grid so the elements line up.
exampleTrans: 打开吸附网格，让元素对齐。

name: raster
example: Raster images get blurry when you scale them up.
exampleTrans: 位图放大后会变模糊。

name: SVG
example: Export the logo as SVG so its edges remain crisp.
exampleTrans: 将标志导出为 SVG，使边缘保持清晰。

name: PNG
trans: n. PNG 图片格式（支持透明）
example: Use a PNG with a transparent background for the logo.
exampleTrans: logo 用透明背景的 PNG。

name: pixel density
example: Export 2x and 3x assets for high pixel density screens.
exampleTrans: 为高像素密度屏幕导出 2 倍和 3 倍图。

name: slice
example: Mark the slices so developers can export the assets.
exampleTrans: 标好切图，方便开发导出资源。

name: pattern library
trans: n. 模式库；组件模式库
example: Check the pattern library before designing a new date picker.
exampleTrans: 设计新的日期选择器前先查一下模式库。

name: style tile
trans: n. 风格样板（展示配色、字体等视觉方向）
example: Let's share two style tiles with the client before the full mockup.
exampleTrans: 在做完整效果图前，先给客户看两套风格样板。

name: logo
example: The logo is too small in the navigation bar.
exampleTrans: 导航栏里的 logo 太小了。

name: favicon
trans: n. 网站图标（浏览器标签页图标）
example: The favicon is hard to see on dark browser tabs.
exampleTrans: 网站图标在深色标签页上看不清。

name: disabled state
example: The disabled state needs enough contrast to still be readable.
exampleTrans: 禁用状态也要有足够的对比度，保证可读。

name: micro-interaction
example: A small micro-interaction confirms that the item was saved.
exampleTrans: 一个小小的微交互确认条目已保存。

name: keyframe
example: Add a keyframe at 200 milliseconds to slow the ease-out.
exampleTrans: 在 200 毫秒处加一个关键帧，让缓出更慢。

name: snackbar
trans: n. 底部提示条（短暂提示，可带操作）
example: Show a snackbar with an Undo action after deleting.
exampleTrans: 删除后显示带“撤销”按钮的底部提示条。

name: drawer
trans: n. 抽屉（侧边滑出的面板）
example: Open the filters in a drawer on mobile.
exampleTrans: 移动端把筛选项放在抽屉里打开。

name: popover
example: Show the details in a popover instead of a new page.
exampleTrans: 在气泡卡片里显示详情，而不是打开新页面。

name: navigation bar
example: Keep the navigation bar fixed at the top while scrolling.
exampleTrans: 滚动时导航栏固定在顶部。

name: form field
example: Each form field needs a visible label, not just a placeholder.
exampleTrans: 每个表单字段都需要可见的标签，不能只有占位文字。

name: WCAG
trans: n. 网页内容无障碍指南
example: The text must meet the WCAG AA contrast ratio.
exampleTrans: 文字必须达到 WCAG AA 级的对比度要求。

name: alt text
trans: n. 替代文本（图片的文字描述）
example: Every image in the article needs alt text for screen readers.
exampleTrans: 文章里的每张图都需要为读屏软件提供替代文本。

name: touch target
trans: n. 触控区域；可点击区域
example: Make the touch target at least 44 by 44 points.
exampleTrans: 触控区域至少要 44×44 点。

name: color space
example: Choose the correct color space before exporting production assets.
exampleTrans: 导出生产资源前，请选择正确的色彩空间。

name: color gamut
example: The display cannot reproduce every color in this color gamut.
exampleTrans: 这块显示屏无法呈现该色域中的所有颜色。

name: alpha channel
trans: n. Alpha 通道（透明度通道）
example: The alpha channel preserves transparency around the exported icon.
exampleTrans: Alpha 通道保留了导出图标周围的透明效果。

name: color profile
example: Embed the color profile to prevent unexpected shifts after export.
exampleTrans: 嵌入色彩配置文件可避免导出后发生意外偏色。

name: spot color
example: The printer requested a spot color for the metallic logo.
exampleTrans: 印刷厂要求金属质感标志使用专色。

name: duotone
example: A duotone treatment keeps campaign illustrations visually consistent.
exampleTrans: 双色调处理让活动插图在视觉上保持一致。

name: color ramp
example: The color ramp provides accessible shades for every interaction state.
exampleTrans: 色阶为每种交互状态提供了无障碍的明暗层级。

name: foreground
example: Increase the foreground contrast against this tinted background.
exampleTrans: 提高前景与这个浅色背景之间的对比度。

name: background color
example: The background color should remain neutral behind product photography.
exampleTrans: 产品照片后面的背景色应保持中性。

name: cap height
example: The cap height makes this typeface feel larger at equal sizes.
exampleTrans: 相同字号下，大写字母高度让这款字体显得更大。

name: font style
example: Create a font style for every approved heading level.
exampleTrans: 为每个获批的标题层级创建字体样式。

name: font pairing
example: This font pairing separates editorial headlines from interface labels.
exampleTrans: 这组字体搭配区分了编辑标题与界面标签。

name: variable font
example: A variable font reduces files while supporting many weights.
exampleTrans: 可变字体在支持多种字重的同时减少了文件数量。

name: font fallback
example: Specify a font fallback for scripts unsupported by our brand typeface.
exampleTrans: 为品牌字体不支持的文字系统指定备用字体。

name: text alignment
example: Keep text alignment consistent across cards in the same row.
exampleTrans: 同一行卡片中的文本对齐方式应保持一致。

name: rag
trans: n. 参差边（文本未对齐一侧的轮廓）
example: Adjust the column width to improve the paragraph rag.
exampleTrans: 调整栏宽以改善段落边缘的参差形状。

name: type hierarchy
example: A clear type hierarchy helps users scan dense settings pages.
exampleTrans: 清晰的文字层级帮助用户浏览信息密集的设置页面。

name: vertical rhythm
example: Consistent spacing creates vertical rhythm across the article page.
exampleTrans: 一致的间距在文章页面中形成垂直韵律。

name: layout grid
example: The layout grid aligns content across desktop breakpoints.
exampleTrans: 版式网格让内容在各桌面断点下保持对齐。

name: fluid layout
example: A fluid layout adapts smoothly between our defined breakpoints.
exampleTrans: 流式布局能在既定断点之间平滑适配。

name: fixed width
example: The fixed width sidebar leaves more room for reading.
exampleTrans: 固定宽度的侧栏为阅读留出了更多空间。

name: maximum width
example: Set a maximum width so long paragraphs remain readable.
exampleTrans: 设置最大宽度，让较长段落仍然易读。

name: intrinsic size
example: The image keeps its intrinsic size inside the flexible container.
exampleTrans: 图片在弹性容器中保持其固有尺寸。

name: responsive grid
example: Our responsive grid collapses from twelve columns to four.
exampleTrans: 我们的响应式网格会从十二栏缩减为四栏。

name: spacing scale
example: Use the spacing scale instead of arbitrary pixel values.
exampleTrans: 请使用间距量表，而不是任意像素值。

name: z-index
example: The modal z-index must place it above the navigation.
exampleTrans: 模态框的堆叠层级必须高于导航栏。

name: component state
example: Document each component state before handing designs to engineering.
exampleTrans: 交付研发前，请记录每一种组件状态。

name: component property
example: This component property switches the card between compact and spacious layouts.
exampleTrans: 这个组件属性用于切换卡片的紧凑和宽松布局。

name: slot
example: The card slot accepts either an illustration or product image.
exampleTrans: 卡片插槽可以放置插图或产品图片。

name: combobox
example: Use a combobox when users may enter a custom value.
exampleTrans: 当用户可以输入自定义值时，请使用组合框。

name: disclosure
example: The disclosure reveals advanced settings without opening another page.
exampleTrans: 展开控件无需打开新页面即可显示高级设置。

name: listbox
example: The listbox highlights the currently selected shipping method.
exampleTrans: 列表框会突出显示当前选中的配送方式。

name: status indicator
example: The status indicator combines color with a descriptive label.
exampleTrans: 状态指示器将颜色与描述性标签结合使用。

name: scrim
example: The dark scrim separates the dialog from background content.
exampleTrans: 深色遮罩层将对话框与背景内容分隔开。

name: focus ring
example: The focus ring remains visible against every button color.
exampleTrans: 焦点环在每种按钮颜色上都保持可见。

name: hit area
example: Expand the hit area without changing the icon's visual size.
exampleTrans: 扩大点击区域，同时不改变图标的视觉尺寸。

name: safe zone
example: Keep essential text inside the banner's safe zone.
exampleTrans: 把重要文字放在横幅的安全区域内。

name: optical size
example: Optical size improves letterforms at small interface sizes.
exampleTrans: 光学字号改善了小尺寸界面文字的字形。

name: pixel grid
example: Align thin icon strokes to the pixel grid.
exampleTrans: 将图标的细描边对齐到像素网格。

name: design QA
example: Design QA found inconsistent padding in the implemented dialog.
exampleTrans: 设计验收发现实现后的对话框内边距不一致。
